title: Animals of the Wild
text:
Lions live in Africa. They live in groups called prides. A lion can run very fast, and it sleeps for many hours each day.

Elephants are the biggest animals on land. They eat grass, leaves, and fruit. Elephants live in family groups with their babies.

questions.text: Why do elephants probably live in family groups?
options: To find more food in the sky

questions.text: How does a lion probably spend most of its day?

vocabulary.definition: several people or animals that are together

paragraph_translations: Aslanlar Afrika'da yaşar. Onlar pride adı verilen gruplar halinde yaşar. Bir aslan çok hızlı koşabilir ve her gün birçok saat uyur.
Filler karadaki en büyük hayvanlardır. Otlar, yapraklar ve meyve yerler. Filler bebekleriyle birlikte aile grupları halinde yaşar.
